prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1332; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client regarding the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and has retained this firm to pursue all claims arising from it. Please direct all further communication concerning this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide the policy limits of liability coverage under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with a copy of the declarations page, so that we can evaluate the available recovery. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please ensure that no evidence is altered, discarded, or repaired without prior written notice to this office.

We look forward to your prompt written response within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.
